name: North Mini Code
description: Cohere's open-weights sparse Mixture-of-Experts coding model, optimized for agentic software engineering tasks and low-latency edge deployment.
keyFeatures: Sparse MoE with 128 experts (8 active per token)
Post-trained across multiple SWE environments and harnesses
Optimized for local deployment on a single GPU (FP8/FP4)
curatorNotes: First model in Cohere's North series. Specifically designed to automate repository-level coding actions.
